name: Scalded Milk
instructions: Pour milk into a pot/pan on the stove and set temperature to medium-low. This low temperature will keep milk from heating too quickly which also prevents burning; milk should be heated, but not boiling or sticking to the bottom
Stir frequently until steam and bubbles appear at the edge, ~4-5 minutes. Stirring prevents a film from developing on the surface of the milk and disperses heat evenly.
After bubbles and steam are seem, remove from heat and let cool to about 41˚C/105˚F, 5-10 minutes
